notes: v1.14.548 — showPage NO LONGER BLANKS THE APP ON A MISSING PAGE. The legacy page swap ended in a bare if(target) with no else. That is the worst shape of silent failure in the file, because every .page and every .tn-item is deactivated SIX LINES EARLIER: an id with no page did not merely fail to navigate, it left the app on NO ACTIVE PAGE AT ALL — a blank screen, no warning, no toast, nothing thrown. Contract 14, and the exact class v1.14.461 and v1.14.544 were written to end. ⭐ LEGACY-RETIRE made it reachable rather than theoretical: every Stage 6 ship deletes a legacy page while doors to it survive in legacy chrome and in the search index, which routes by page id whenever redesign_isOn() is false (:49067). 6.3 stranded two such doors and every organ still to come strands more. Fixing it at the router covers all of them at once, which is why it ships as its own change instead of a patch per door inside an organ decouple. Now: console.warn naming the id, a toast, and a landing on a REAL page — house-correct, pg-cmd under the redesign and pg-triage under legacy, never the legacy NOW dashboard inside the redesign frame. Three tests in 01-nav pin the invariant that matters: exactly one .page.active, never zero.
